description: List the federal, state, and county senior-benefit programs that apply where a person lives, from their 5-digit ZIP code or their city and state. Each program includes its cited government source URL, a last-verified date, and an apply-guide link on discoverseniorbenefits.com; spoken_summary is a short version to read aloud. Optionally filter by jurisdiction level or category keyword.

category.description: Case-insensitive keyword matched against each program's category (e.g. 'food', 'property tax', 'utilities').

city.description: City or town name as the person said it (e.g. 'Eastvale'). Use with state when the ZIP code is not known.

level.description: Only return programs at this jurisdiction level.

state.description: State for the city: 2-letter code or full name (e.g. 'CA').

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code (or give city + state).

name: find_programs_by_zip
title: Find benefit programs by ZIP code or city
